initial_workflow_planning_team.building_task:
# Team-building brief
Current question: How should R1–R6 be translated into an evidence-efficient workflow, and what exact first numerical batch should be recorded to establish a feasible incumbent while exposing the first consequential Er/Zr/Ni tradeoff? Determining evidence IDs/values: none yet; current_action=needs_plan, allowances are 32 distinct compositions, 16 phase profiles, 12 Scheil calculations, and no measured candidates exist. Unresolved issue: choose a small informative first batch and define the decision logic for downstream Er/Zr refinement and matched-branch Ni comparison without exhausting allowances or skipping the required new Er/Zr refinement. Requested deliverable: a requirements-to-workflow map and flow diagram plus one exact recorded calculation proposal for the first batch, including what returned evidence would resolve this assignment. Returned evidence that would resolve this assignment: a saved initial plan naming exact compositions and calculation family/families for the first numerical action, with rationale tied to R1–R6 and explicit favorable/unfavorable outcome logic for the next refinement. Include Scientific_Critic in planning.

# Current assignment
Plan mode only. Record the initial workflow and the next numerical action. Keep the brief focused: provide (1) a requirements-to-workflow map for R1–R6, (2) an informative first experiment/batch with exact compositions, (3) the specific current question that batch answers, (4) the determining observations that the returned evidence must provide, (5) the unresolved issue that remains after planning, and (6) what returned evidence would let us choose the next Er/Zr refinement or matched-branch Ni comparison. Do not execute calculations. Do not nominate. Scientific_Critic must check that the proposed batch can establish a defensible incumbent first and does not improperly substitute the later controlled Ni comparison for the initial Er/Zr assessment.

# Delegation mode: plan
Selected physics specialists first interpret method knowledge or measured comparisons and uncertainties. The planner then chooses one informative next action and calls record_design_plan. On the first plan, record the requirements map and workflow; later retain them unless an explicit change is needed. The critic checks the evidence, hypothesis and chosen measurement. Code derives fixed/varied composition metadata. Use the active batch limit. Do not calculate physics or nominate final alloys.

agent_configs.name: Alloy_Design_Planner
agent_configs.description: Translates the task into a workflow and informative experiments using specialist advice. In a pre-nomination review assesses further refinement or justified stopping; records the final nomination in execute mode after qualification. Owns sample selection; does not calculate physics.

agent_configs.name: Coarsening_Specialist
agent_configs.description: Interprets measured J trends, practical ties and coarsening tradeoffs before planning. In execution, calculates normalized L12 coarsening J at 250 C with evaluate_coarsening. Supports objective-driven sample selection.

agent_configs.name: Phase_Stability_Specialist
agent_configs.description: Interprets equilibrium phase constraints using matched composition pairs: identifies fixed/varied solutes, service-phase gain, constraint margin and competing-phase costs before planning. In execution calculates L12/Al3Zr at 250/660 C and upper disappearance boundaries with evaluate_phase_stability. Advises improvement of feasible designs using service/high-temperature phase balance and Er/Zr interactions.

agent_configs.name: Solidification_Specialist
agent_configs.description: Interprets solidification effects of Er/Zr refinements and matched Ni comparisons. Calculates terminal Scheil phases and FR/CSC/HCS on assigned compositions; checks downstream costs of upstream coarsening/phase gains and gives focused evidence-linked advice. Does not choose samples.

agent_configs.name: Scientific_Critic
agent_configs.description: Required focused reviewer. Checks the link between measured comparisons, proposed hypothesis and chosen calculation; reviews consequential numerical claims after execution. Requests specific corrections without choosing samples. Performs fresh verification of the nominated preferred candidate/reference and final scientific review. Separates correct scoped results from mission completion; checks primary-objective consistency, genuine composition refinement and branch-specific Ni support.

agent_configs.name: Alloy_Design_Planner
agent_configs.description: Translates the task into a workflow and informative experiments using specialist advice. In a pre-nomination review assesses further refinement or justified stopping; records the final nomination in execute mode after qualification. Owns sample selection; does not calculate physics.

agent_configs.name: Coarsening_Specialist
agent_configs.description: Interprets measured J trends, practical ties and coarsening tradeoffs before planning. In execution, calculates normalized L12 coarsening J at 250 C with evaluate_coarsening. Supports objective-driven sample selection.

agent_configs.name: Phase_Stability_Specialist
agent_configs.description: Interprets equilibrium phase constraints using matched composition pairs: identifies fixed/varied solutes, service-phase gain, constraint margin and competing-phase costs before planning. In execution calculates L12/Al3Zr at 250/660 C and upper disappearance boundaries with evaluate_phase_stability. Advises improvement of feasible designs using service/high-temperature phase balance and Er/Zr interactions.

agent_configs.name: Scientific_Critic
agent_configs.description: Required focused reviewer. Checks the link between measured comparisons, proposed hypothesis and chosen calculation; reviews consequential numerical claims after execution. Requests specific corrections without choosing samples. Performs fresh verification of the nominated preferred candidate/reference and final scientific review. Separates correct scoped results from mission completion; checks primary-objective consistency, genuine composition refinement and branch-specific Ni support.

agent_configs.description: Interprets measured J trends, practical ties and coarsening tradeoffs before planning. In execution, calculates normalized L12 coarsening J at 250 C with evaluate_coarsening. Supports objective-driven sample selection.

agent_configs.name: Scientific_Critic
agent_configs.description: Required focused reviewer. Checks the link between measured comparisons, proposed hypothesis and chosen calculation; reviews consequential numerical claims after execution. Separates correct scoped results from mission completion; checks primary-objective consistency, genuine composition refinement and branch-specific Ni support.

agent_configs.name: Alloy_Design_Planner
agent_configs.description: Translates the task into a workflow and informative experiments using specialist advice. In a pre-nomination review assesses further refinement or justified stopping; records the final nomination in execute mode after qualification. Owns sample selection; does not calculate physics.

agent_configs.name: Phase_Stability_Specialist
agent_configs.description: Interprets equilibrium phase constraints using matched composition pairs: identifies fixed/varied solutes, service-phase gain, constraint margin and competing-phase costs before planning. In execution calculates L12/Al3Zr at 250/660 C and upper disappearance boundaries with evaluate_phase_stability. Advises improvement of feasible designs using service/high-temperature phase balance and Er/Zr interactions.

agent_configs.name: Coarsening_Specialist
agent_configs.description: Interprets measured J trends, practical ties and coarsening tradeoffs before planning. In execution, calculates normalized L12 coarsening J at 250 C with evaluate_coarsening. Supports objective-driven sample selection.

agent_configs.name: Scientific_Critic
agent_configs.description: Required focused reviewer. Checks the link between measured comparisons, proposed hypothesis and chosen calculation; reviews consequential numerical claims after execution. Requests specific corrections without choosing samples. Performs fresh verification of the nominated preferred candidate/reference and final scientific review. Separates correct scoped results from mission completion; checks primary-objective consistency, genuine composition refinement and branch-specific Ni support.

agent_configs.name: Phase_Stability_Specialist
agent_configs.description: Interprets equilibrium phase constraints using matched composition pairs: identifies fixed/varied solutes, service-phase gain, constraint margin and competing-phase costs before planning. In execution calculates L12/Al3Zr at 250/660 C and upper disappearance boundaries with evaluate_phase_stability. Advises improvement of feasible designs using service/high-temperature phase balance and Er/Zr interactions.

agent_configs.name: Scientific_Critic
agent_configs.description: Required focused reviewer. Checks the link between measured comparisons, proposed hypothesis and chosen calculation; reviews consequential numerical claims after execution. Requests specific corrections without choosing samples. Performs fresh verification of the nominated preferred candidate/reference and final scientific review. Separates correct scoped results from mission completion; checks primary-objective consistency, genuine composition refinement and branch-specific Ni support.

agent_configs.name: Alloy_Design_Planner
agent_configs.description: Translates the task into a workflow and informative experiments using specialist advice. In a pre-nomination review assesses further refinement or justified stopping; records the final nomination in execute mode after qualification. Owns sample selection; does not calculate physics.

agent_configs.name: Coarsening_Specialist
agent_configs.description: Interprets measured J trends, practical ties and coarsening tradeoffs before planning. In execution, calculates normalized L12 coarsening J at 250 C with evaluate_coarsening. Supports objective-driven sample selection.

agent_configs.name: Phase_Stability_Specialist
agent_configs.description: Interprets equilibrium phase constraints using matched composition pairs: identifies fixed/varied solutes, service-phase gain, constraint margin and competing-phase costs before planning. In execution calculates L12/Al3Zr at 250/660 C and upper disappearance boundaries with evaluate_phase_stability. Advises improvement of feasible designs using service/high-temperature phase balance and Er/Zr interactions.

agent_configs.name: Scientific_Critic
agent_configs.description: Required focused reviewer. Checks the link between measured comparisons, proposed hypothesis and chosen calculation; reviews consequential numerical claims after execution. Requests specific corrections without choosing samples. Performs fresh verification of the nominated preferred candidate/reference and final scientific review. Separates correct scoped results from mission completion; checks primary-objective consistency, genuine composition refinement and branch-specific Ni support.

Requests specific corrections without choosing samples. Performs fresh verification of the nominated preferred candidate/reference and final scientific review. Separates correct scoped results from mission completion; checks primary-objective consistency, genuine composition refinement and branch-specific Ni support.

# Current assignment
Plan mode only. Using the saved evidence, decide whether C004 should be retained over C003 for downstream matched-branch Ni tuning under the J-first tie rule, then record one exact next numerical action for the required controlled Ni comparison at fixed Er/Zr on that retained branch. Keep the brief focused. For the chosen building_task and execution_task, provide: the current question, determining evidence IDs/values, unresolved issue, requested deliverable, and what returned evidence would resolve this assignment. Do not execute calculations. Do not nominate. The plan must specify the exact Ni comparison composition(s) and required calculation family or families for the next action, while preserving allowances. Explain what favorable and unfavorable outcomes would mean for shortlist selection.

# Delegation mode: plan
Selected physics specialists first interpret method knowledge or measured comparisons and uncertainties. The planner then chooses one informative next action and calls record_design_plan. On the first plan, record the requirements map and workflow; later retain them unless an explicit change is needed. The critic checks the evidence, hypothesis and chosen measurement. Code derives fixed/varied composition metadata. Use the active batch limit. Do not calculate physics or nominate final alloys.

agent_configs.name: Alloy_Design_Planner
agent_configs.description: Translates the task into a workflow and informative experiments using specialist advice. In a pre-nomination review assesses further refinement or justified stopping; records the final nomination in execute mode after qualification. Owns sample selection; does not calculate physics.

agent_configs.name: Coarsening_Specialist
agent_configs.description: Interprets measured J trends, practical ties and coarsening tradeoffs before planning. In execution, calculates normalized L12 coarsening J at 250 C with evaluate_coarsening. Supports objective-driven sample selection.

agent_configs.name: Phase_Stability_Specialist
agent_configs.description: Interprets equilibrium phase constraints using matched composition pairs: identifies fixed/varied solutes, service-phase gain, constraint margin and competing-phase costs before planning. In execution calculates L12/Al3Zr at 250/660 C and upper disappearance boundaries with evaluate_phase_stability. Advises improvement of feasible designs using service/high-temperature phase balance and Er/Zr interactions.

agent_configs.name: Scientific_Critic
agent_configs.description: Required focused reviewer. Checks the link between measured comparisons, proposed hypothesis and chosen calculation; reviews consequential numerical claims after execution. Requests specific corrections without choosing samples. Performs fresh verification of the nominated preferred candidate/reference and final scientific review. Separates correct scoped results from mission completion; checks primary-objective consistency, genuine composition refinement and branch-specific Ni support.

agent_configs.name: Alloy_Design_Planner
agent_configs.description: Translates the task into a workflow and informative experiments using specialist advice. In a pre-nomination review assesses further refinement or justified stopping; records the final nomination in execute mode after qualification. Owns sample selection; does not calculate physics.

agent_configs.name: Phase_Stability_Specialist
agent_configs.description: Interprets equilibrium phase constraints using matched composition pairs: identifies fixed/varied solutes, service-phase gain, constraint margin and competing-phase costs before planning. In execution calculates L12/Al3Zr at 250/660 C and upper disappearance boundaries with evaluate_phase_stability. Advises improvement of feasible designs using service/high-temperature phase balance and Er/Zr interactions.

agent_configs.name: Coarsening_Specialist
agent_configs.description: Interprets measured J trends, practical ties and coarsening tradeoffs before planning. In execution, calculates normalized L12 coarsening J at 250 C with evaluate_coarsening. Supports objective-driven sample selection.

agent_configs.name: Scientific_Critic
agent_configs.description: Required focused reviewer. Checks the link between measured comparisons, proposed hypothesis and chosen calculation; reviews consequential numerical claims after execution. Requests specific corrections without choosing samples. Performs fresh verification of the nominated preferred candidate/reference and final scientific review. Separates correct scoped results from mission completion; checks primary-objective consistency, genuine composition refinement and branch-specific Ni support.

agent_configs.name: Alloy_Design_Planner
agent_configs.description: Translates the task into a workflow and informative experiments using specialist advice. In a pre-nomination review assesses further refinement or justified stopping; records the final nomination in execute mode after qualification. Owns sample selection; does not calculate physics.

agent_configs.name: Solidification_Specialist
agent_configs.description: Interprets solidification effects of Er/Zr refinements and matched Ni comparisons. Calculates terminal Scheil phases and FR/CSC/HCS on assigned compositions; checks downstream costs of upstream coarsening/phase gains and gives focused evidence-linked advice. Does not choose samples.

agent_configs.name: Coarsening_Specialist
agent_configs.description: Interprets measured J trends, practical ties and coarsening tradeoffs before planning. In execution, calculates normalized L12 coarsening J at 250 C with evaluate_coarsening. Supports objective-driven sample selection.

agent_configs.name: Scientific_Critic
agent_configs.description: Required focused reviewer. Checks the link between measured comparisons, proposed hypothesis and chosen calculation; reviews consequential numerical claims after execution. Requests specific corrections without choosing samples. Performs fresh verification of the nominated preferred candidate/reference and final scientific review. Separates correct scoped results from mission completion; checks primary-objective consistency, genuine composition refinement and branch-specific Ni support.
